title: Locally noetherian restricted fibres
statement: Let f:X→T be locally finitely presented after restriction to an open U⊆T. For t∈U, the fibre X_t is locally noetherian.

source.place: Tag 054U, fibre locally of finite type over a field

proof.text: Form the fibre map of the restriction pullback square at t in U. Its residue-field base map is an isomorphism, so the fibre map is an isomorphism. The restricted fibre is locally of finite type over the residue field and locally noetherian by LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian. Apply isLocallyNoetherian_of_isOpenImmersion to the inverse fibre isomorphism.
